_comment: PNW ADU — Hayden's dad's new ADU company, Enumclaw/Buckley plateau. NOTHING about the business itself is verified yet (Recon/pnw-adu.md §6): every null below is a real unknown, never guessed on the page. The QA fact checks skip null phone/address/hours by design. BUILD IS PITCH/PUBLISH-BLOCKED (photo-blocked + publish_gate below). Hero (9/14 evening, Hayden): the ADD-ON FARMHOUSE concept render as a matched day/dusk pair — REV 2 (9/15 evening, Hayden): ONE slow one-way sweep on load — day → a golden sunset midpoint → dusk, ~8 s — then still; the drag/hover toy is GONE; depth parallax stays — labelled 'concept'. No sign board; the name lives in the header only. Bubbles show stills only (no push-in clips). The service map uses a 12.5-mile circle from Buckley, deliberately excluding Puyallup and Auburn while retaining Sumner and Orting. The process section is one 'We handle it start to finish' band; the site mark is images/mark-lockup.png.

process: single band — 'We handle it start to finish.' + five illustrated steps: Walk Your Space, Creating the Vision, Plan to Paper, Experienced Execution, The Day Has Come.

asks_for_dad: 1. The name as he says it — PNW ADU / PNW ADU LLC? Registered business name + UBI; buy pnw-adu.com (unregistered 9/14) and say which registrar so DNS can point at GitHub Pages.

2. Photos — finished ADU whole from the yard at blue hour (two tripod frames: lights off / lights on), same unit in daylight, two whole-room interiors, the truck on a lot with the door readable, dad on site at work, any framing sequence, the mill/lumber stack if real, any existing lettering (original file). Until then the hero and the bubble frames are Higgsfield concept renders, every one tagged 'concept'.

3. Offer line — design-build turnkey? permits handled in-house? site work / septic / utilities? stick-built only or prefab set too? attached + garage conversions, or detached only? (decides the sub line and the five bubble lines — the fifth bubble is 'Inside the house' (basement/attic apartment, a KCC-recognised ADU type); the first build's 'Studio or shop' line was dropped 9/14 as an offer nobody gave. Until he answers, the page promises no permitting and no new-garage construction.)
4. WA contractor license number as printed + bonded/insured line — fills the hidden stake in #trust and the L&I link.
5. Service towns — confirm or edit the service range shown by the 12.5-mile circle around Buckley; current local review keeps Sumner and Orting in, Puyallup and Auburn out.
6. First project story — whose ADU (with permission), why, what, which county/city permitted it, start-to-keys time.
7. Years in construction + what Jared has built — fills the hidden 'years building' stake; numbers must be true.
8. Price posture — show ranges? 'From $___'? or 'walk the lot first'? Is the lot walk free? Numbers incl. tax? (no prices are on the site until he answers)

9. Contact + lead path — business phone (a cell that takes texts?), email, where form submissions go, hours he'll answer; Google Business Profile exists? (the Call button is `hidden` until a number exists — un-hide with a tel: href)
10. Rules confirmation — has he pulled a permit under the new Pierce code? Which planner at Pierce PPW / King DLS / Enumclaw / Buckley should answer a homeowner's address-specific question?
11. Tone — three sentences of how he'd describe the work to a neighbour, recorded not written, so the copy can be re-cut in his voice.

map_assets.ground: images/map/plateau30-dusk-web.jpg (2304x1856, q82 web copy of images/map/plateau30-dusk.jpg — the Higgsfield blue-hour re-render of images/map/naip-30mi.jpg, a 3200x2560 USGS NAIP Web Mercator export; bbox in images/map/map-30mi.json)
map_assets.alignment_verified: 2026-09-14: dusk render vs NAIP at the nominal 0.72 x / 0.725 y scale — water-mask template match on Lake Tapps (+0,+1 px), Alder Lake (-2,+2), American Lake (-5,+1), Commencement Bay (-5,-1), Lake Youngs (0,0), Puget Sound/Vashon (-1,+2); max 5 px = 0.22% of the frame; whole-frame ORB/RANSAC fit scale 1.0048, rot -0.11 deg, shift (-4,-5) px, 332 inliers. No fit applied — nominal scale used.
map_assets.projection: x = (lon - W)/(E - W) * 2304; y = (merc(N) - merc(lat))/(merc(N) - merc(S)) * 1856; 28.373 px per mile at Buckley; the 12.5-mile service-circle radius is 354.7 px; Buckley at (50.00%, 50.22%)
map_assets.crop: The plane is sized so the 12.5-mile service circle nearly fills the frame with 12 px of air — plane width = (frame's shorter side − 24 px) / .3079 (ring diameter / image width); phones square, ≥760 13:10 (ring fills the height)
